facts.fact: The director general of the population directorate says it is working on an interoperability system that will let public administrations, and some institutions such as banks and social protection bodies, check a national ID card's authenticity in real time; no launch is stated.

systems.owner: Direction générale de la Population et de la Famille
systems.tiers: public administrations, banks, social protection bodies

note: Date is the document's published date, which the interview gives no separate event date for.
